answer: The relic assignment is published and terrace records each panel. Shards are assigned from the forge graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1240 impostors cost 1269 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
